description: This file is a shell script written in sh that sets up and runs a suite of tests related to Git's revision listing and path optimization features. It includes test descriptions, environment setup, and test cases with assertions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A function used to define a test case that expects success; it takes a description and a shell commands block to execute.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: A function to update the commit timestamp to ensure unique commit times during test setup.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: A function to compare expected and actual outputs, typically for test verification.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: A function to mark the end of the test suite.
